resources.string: How to do each act properly. The farz parts are in gold.
Gold = farz. The dashed gold line is the limit that must be covered.
Kulli and water in the nose
In wuzu, kulli and water in the nose are sunnat. In ghusl they are farz, so do not leave them out.
Farz (4): if one is missed, the wuzu is not valid

string-array.name: faraiz_wuzu_farz
string-array.item: Wash the whole face: hairline to below the chin, earlobe to earlobe. Wetting it is not enough; water must flow over it.
Wash both arms, including the elbows.
Masah of the head: at least ¼ of the head.
Wash both feet, including the ankles.

string-array.name: faraiz_wuzu_sunnat
string-array.item: Niyyat (intention)
Bismillah at the start
Wash both hands up to the wrists, 3 times
Miswak
Kulli, 3 times, fresh water each time
Water in the nose, 3 times, and clean it with the left hand
Khilal of the beard (men)
Khilal of the fingers and toes
Wash each limb 3 times
Masah of the whole head, once
Masah of both ears with the same water
Tarteeb: the order given in the Quran
Muwalat: wash the next limb before the last one dries
Start with the right side

string-array.name: faraiz_wuzu_breaks
string-array.item: Anything leaving the front or back private part (urine, stool, etc.)
Passing wind
Vomiting a mouthful
Sleeping lying down, or leaning so that you would fall if the support were taken away
Fainting or losing consciousness
Losing sanity, or intoxication
Laughing aloud inside namaz (not in janazah)
Blood or pus flowing beyond the mouth of the wound

string-array.name: faraiz_wuzu_not_breaks
string-array.item: A drop of blood that does not flow
Someone seeing your hair (that is a sin of its own, but the wuzu stays)

string-array.name: faraiz_wuzu_steps
string-array.item: Niyyat and Bismillah
Wash both hands up to the wrists, 3 times
Kulli, 3 times
Water in the nose, 3 times; clean it with the left hand
Wash the whole face: hairline to below the chin, earlobe to earlobe
Wash the right arm, then the left, including the elbows
Masah of the head: at least ¼ (sunnat: the whole head, once)
Masah of both ears with the same water
Wash the right foot, then the left, including the ankles
Khilal of the fingers and toes

string-array.name: faraiz_ghusl_farz
string-array.item: Kulli: rinse the whole mouth (gargling is sunnat if not fasting)
Naak mein pani: up to the soft part of the nose, then blow it out
Wash the whole body: if a spot the size of a hair is left dry, the ghusl is not valid

string-array.name: faraiz_ghusl_sunnat
string-array.item: Bismillah
Niyyat
Wash both hands to the wrists
Wash off najasat and the private parts
Make wuzu
Pour water over the whole body 3 times
Head first, then the right shoulder, then the left shoulder
Rub the body
No gaps (muwalat)

string-array.name: faraiz_ghusl_steps
string-array.item: Wash both hands to the wrists
Wash off najasat and the private parts
Make wuzu
Kulli: rinse the whole mouth
Water in the nose, up to the soft part, then blow it out
Water over the whole body 3 times: head, right shoulder, left shoulder

string-array.name: faraiz_ghusl_dont_miss_items
string-array.item: The navel
The backs of the ears
Under rings and nose-pins
Braided hair: the roots must get wet; the braids don\'t have to be opened

resources.string: When water can\'t be found, or using it would cause harm (illness).

string-array.name: faraiz_tayammum_farz
string-array.item: Niyyat: the intention is needed in tayammum (unlike wuzu)
Masah of the whole face
Masah of both arms, including the elbows

string-array.name: faraiz_tayammum_steps
string-array.item: Niyyat
Bismillah
Strike both palms on clean earth, stone or dust
Wipe the whole face
Strike a second time
Wipe the right arm up to and including the elbow, then the left

resources.string: Everything that breaks wuzu, plus the excuse ending (water becomes available, or the illness gets better).

string-array.name: faraiz_shuroot
string-array.item: Body clean of hadas (in wuzu or ghusl)
Body and clothes free of najasat
The place is clean
Satr covered (for women: the whole body except the face, the hands and the feet)
The namaz time has started
Facing the qibla
Niyyat

resources.string: Many Urdu books say 6 sharait by joining items 2 and 3.

string-array.name: faraiz_arkan
string-array.item: Takbeer-e-tahreema
Qiyam (standing)
Qirat
Ruku
Both sajdas
Qada-e-akheerah: sitting at the end for as long as it takes to read the tashahhud

resources.string: If one is missed by mistake, sajda-e-sahw fixes it. If one is missed on purpose, the namaz is repeated.

string-array.name: faraiz_wajibat
string-array.item: Surah Fatiha, in the first 2 rakat of fard and in every rakat of witr, sunnat and nafl
A surah (3 short ayaat or 1 long ayah) after the Fatiha
The Fatiha before the surah
Repeated acts in order (the second sajda straight after the first)
Ta\'deel-e-arkan: stay still in each position
Qada-e-oola (the first sitting) and the tashahhud in both sittings
Stand up for the 3rd rakat straight after the tashahhud
Dua-e-qunoot in witr
The extra takbeers of Eid
Loud qirat (imam) in Fajr, Maghrib and Isha (first 2 rakat), Jumu\'ah, Eid and taraweeh
Quiet qirat in Zuhr, Asr and the later rakat
End with salam

string-array.name: faraiz_positions
string-array.item: Takbeer-e-tahreema: hands up to the shoulders
Qiyam: stand, hands on the chest
Ruku: body drawn together
Qawma: stand up and stay still
Sajda: body drawn together
Jalsa: sit still between the two sajdas
Qada: sit with both feet out to the right
Salam: end the namaz with salam
